Team —

Quick summary and ask: we need to lock the high‑level stage gates for the 2027 performance cycle this week and finalize the manager-facing packet (checklist, comm templates, and the privacy / privileged‑role routing notes). The draft materials are attached (stagegate_calendar.ics, manager_checklist.pdf, privacy_routing_slides.pdf).

Key proposal (high level):
- Stage 0 (Manager prep & calibration): Apr 18–May 2 — training sessions + calibration forum
- Stage 1 (Self-assessments & manager drafts): May 3–May 16 — managers collect self-assessments and save drafts in the private Drive folder
- Stage 2 (Calibration & conflict resolution): May 17–May 23 — restricted access; privileged roles handled through the Privacy Ops lane
- Stage 3 (Finalization & signoff): May 24–Jun 2 — managers confirm ratings + finalize documentation; manager acknowledgement required via DocuSign
- Stage 4 (Comp & career conversations): Jun 7–Jun 21 — individual meetings; quiet launch for sensitive cases begins Jun 14 if needed

Privacy / privileged roles note: when a report involves a privileged role (T1/T2), the manager must follow the Privacy Ops checklist on slide 6. That includes a redaction pass and a short evidence bundle (audit logs, limited feedback excerpts).

Decisions needed by EOD Monday (Apr 5):
1) Approve the stage dates above (or propose changes)
2) Confirm owner for manager acknowledgement flow (DocuSign link in related links)
3) Approve the redaction guidance: I attached a first pass (redaction_guidance.docx) — legal has to sign off but we can lock ops behavior now

Please reply with a single line ack + any blockers. If you prefer a 30‑min sync instead of email, I can book tomorrow.

— Tessa

Hi Tessa / team —

Thanks for the packet. A few pragmatic suggestions from the consultant side based on similar cycles:

1) Evidence bundle minimal set: manager statement (1–2 bullets), timestamped audit log extract (last 12 months), and anonymized feedback excerpts (max 2). Keep everything under a single encrypted folder per case.
2) Redaction checklist: add explicit guidance for manager language to avoid (no salary references in feedback, no direct comparison to other named individuals).
3) Dry run: run the privacy lane on two real sample cases next week (not live) to validate timing and the DocuSign trigger. We typically need 48–72 hours for final redaction once the manager flags a case.

Legal note (cc’ed Julie): if you want, I can draft a 1‑page redaction policy that legal can convert to formal guidance.

— Michael Long
Senior Consultant, HR Consults LLC

- Dry run: we will run two dry‑run privileged cases during the week of Apr 12; Michael will help design the dry run; Julie will review the redaction policy draft.

Action items (owners & ETA):
